verdict.rationale: Package-manager CLIs interact with registries and could plausibly offer commands to create scoped or read-only registry tokens, so this axis applies to pnpm. The evidence pack documents no credential-issuing capability. The ability to put env variables in config files is an adjacent feature, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
